venue.details: Additional venue details TBA on competition website

items.information:
This is a WCA competition presented in conjunction with SkillCon 2015. Registration fees will cover admission for SkillCon; check the [SkillCon website](http://skillcon.org/) for more info on the other events and seminars that will be going on.

Saturday will be a regular competition with 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 3x3OH, 3x3BLD, Pyraminx and Skewb. Awards for these events will be presented at the end of Saturday. Registration fee for Saturday will be $35 + $5 per event.

On Sunday, single rounds of 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, Megaminx, Clock, 4BLD, 5BLD and Multi-BLD will be held as qualifiers for US Nationals 2017. These will be a chance for currently non-qualified competitors to get a qualifying result in order to be eligible for these events at US Nationals 2017. Registration fee for Sunday will be $35 + $5 per event

Registration at the door will cost $50 and will be limited to 3x3 speedsolve only on Saturday.
